name: aws-tech-blog-writer
description: Use when the user wants a post for the AWS Tech Blog (aws.amazon.com/ko/blogs/tech) about a project, PoC, or customer engagement built on AWS: a customer case study, an implementation walkthrough, or an architecture deep dive, even if they only say '블로그 글 써줘' with project documents attached. The writer skill produces the draft from the project sources and hands it to the plugin's second skill, aws-blog-review, which fact-checks it against current AWS docs, checks captions, official names with links, and story, and delivers a report, a revised draft, and a Word (.docx) file named after the post with colour-coded placeholders wherever only the author knows the fact. aws-blog-review also reviews a finished draft on its own. Korean triggers: AWS 기술 블로그 글 작성, AWS 블로그 기고, 테크 블로그 초안, 프로젝트 소개 블로그, 고객 사례 블로그, PoC 블로그, 블로그 포스팅 써줘, 블로그 리뷰, 블로그 검토.
